{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'PYEOF'
# fix ugly expression in ttl test
p = 'tests/test_tagged_m3.py'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace("float('nan'), '10', None + 0 if False else [1], object():", "float('nan'), '10', [1], object():")
open(p, 'w').write(s)

# make currsize expire first (consistent with upstream TTLCache.currsize)
p = 'src/cachetools/tagged.py'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace("""    @property
    def currsize(self):
        \"\"\"The current number of entries in the cache.\"\"\"
        return len(self.__data)""",
"""    @property
    def currsize(self):
        \"\"\"The current number of entries in the cache.\"\"\"
        self.__expire_all(self.__timer())
        return len(self.__data)""")
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('patched')
PYEOF
PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
